cc:Work.dc:title: Capacity and matched procurement
cc:Work.dc:description: For 2026–2028, initial Top3 base capacity is 4.07, 5.81 and 7.83 EB; low–high bounds are 3.56–4.57, 4.90–6.61 and 5.89–10.28 EB. Matched 1q procurement is 3.40, 4.07 and 4.91 EB; 4q procurement is 3.49, 6.02 and 7.24 EB.
